Weather System: Tropical Cyclone UWAN
Issued at: 11:00 AM, 10 November 2025(Monday)

ORANGE WARNING LEVEL: Zambales(Santa Cruz, Candelaria, Masinloc, Palauig, Iba).
ASSOCIATED HAZARD: FLOODING is still THREATENING.

YELLOW WARNING LEVEL: Tarlac, Pampanga, Bataan, Nueva Ecija, Bulacan, Rizal, Metro Manila, Cavite, Batangas, Laguna, Zambales(Olongapo, Subic, Botolan, San Marcelino, Cabangan, Castillejos, San Antonio, San Felipe, San Narciso) and Quezon(Candelaria, Dolores, San Antonio, Sariaya, Tiaong, General Nakar, Tayabas, Infanta, Lucban, Lucena, Mauban, Pagbilao, Real, Sampaloc).
